title: Pitfalls of Dependency-Ready Decoding for Masked Diffusion Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.33823v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Masked diffusion models (MDMs) have shown strong performance on structured reasoning tasks such as Sudoku, Trip Planning, and Countdown. MDMs introduce a freedom in the order in which tokens may be unmasked, and to exercise this freedom for good accuracy, early decoding strategies relied on signals of confidence or the downstream impact of decoding a token. However, simple examples seem to illustrate that resolving a token's dependencies before unmasking it should be important. Therefore, we examine whether this principle, which we call dependency-ready decoding, would contribute to better accuracy, from a practical and a theoretical perspective. We examine a recent decoder that implements dependency-readiness through attention, and generally find that when it performs better than confidence-based or future utility baselines, its decoding order collapses to left-to-right decoding. translated_title: 掩码扩散语言模型中“依赖就绪”解码的陷阱
translated_abstract: 掩码扩散模型（MDMs）在数独、行程规划和Countdown等结构化推理任务上展现出强大的性能。MDM引入了token去掩码顺序上的自由度，为了利用这种自由度获得更好的准确率，早期的解码策略依赖于置信度信号或解码某个token所产生的下游影响。然而，简单的例子似乎表明，在去掩码某个token之前先解决其依赖关系应当是很重要的。因此，我们从实践和理论两个角度检验了这一原则（我们称之为“依赖就绪解码”）是否有助于提升准确率。我们研究了一个通过注意力机制实现依赖就绪的近期解码器，总体上发现：当它比基于置信度或未来效用的基线表现更好时，其解码顺序会坍缩为从左到右的顺序解码。在理论分析方面，我们建立了一个……的定义（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本研究揭示了掩码扩散模型中“依赖就绪”解码策略的局限性：当该策略优于基于置信度或未来效用的基线方法时，其解码顺序实际上会退化成从左到右的顺序解码。
en_tdlr: This study reveals the pitfalls of dependency-ready decoding for masked diffusion language models: whenever it outperforms confidence-based or future-utility baselines, its decoding order effectively collapses to left-to-right decoding.
